parent_objective: audit fresh corrected profile repeat against M1209 before choosing synthesis or another repeat
blocked_by: M1212 repeat completed but differs materially from M1209 and must be audited before another training step
supersedes: interpreting M1212 alone without M1209 comparison
invalidates: claiming stable profile ranking from one public seed block

public_gates: M1213 may audit M1209 and M1212 artifacts only
M1213 must compare L2/current-tiled and L3/reset trends across both public seed blocks
M1213 must classify whether M1212 matched M1209, conflicted with M1209, or produced a new stable direction
M1213 must not use private holdout
M1213 must not claim paper-level evidence or self-identification
forbidden_shortcuts: do not tune profiles based on M1212
do not claim stable architecture ranking from one repeat
do not claim recurrent belief or self-identification without causal history gates

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: classifies whether corrected profile trends are stable across M1209 and M1212
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no promotion private-holdout paper-level generalization recurrent-belief or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if M1212 artifacts are incomplete
stop if eval semantics did not apply corrected controls
stop if interpretation requires private holdout
fallback_plan: route to combined synthesis if trend classifications are clear
route to another fresh repeat only if uncertainty remains high and resource use is justified
route to profile/architecture repair if controls consistently explain temporal claims
route to stronger history-causality gates only if online-vs-reset advantage is stable enough
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1212 completed fresh repeat and must be compared to M1209

admission_evidence: M1209 and M1212 both completed all 24 public seed runs
M1212 recorded profile_seed_rows eval_rows profile_aggregate and summary artifacts
M1212 kept private holdout promotion per-profile tuning actor-input changes and self-ID claims disabled
blocked_shortcuts: do not make performance promotion paper-level or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: L2 current-tiled implication is classified across both blocks
L3 reset-control implication is classified across both blocks
next repeat synthesis or repair milestone is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1213 must decide whether current-tiled controls consistently explain L2 behavior across M1209 and M1212.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1213 can audit public repeat stability but cannot upgrade it to causal self-ID proof.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Record conflicting or parity results as negative/inconclusive evidence and route to synthesis or stronger causal gates.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: M1209 and M1212 corrected public profile artifacts can be compared to decide whether the branch should synthesize, repeat again, or move to stronger causal history tests.
success_criteria: M1209 and M1212 aggregates are compared
L2 normal-vs-current-tiled implication is classified across both seed blocks
L3 online-vs-corrected-reset implication is classified across both seed blocks
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, profile tuning, or actor-input contract expansion occurs
next synthesis, repeat, repair, or causal-gate milestone is selected
failure_criteria: metrics are framed as paper-level evidence
self-identification is claimed from public repeat aggregates

commands.name: audit_corrected_profile_repeat
commands.command: audit M1209 and M1212 corrected public profile artifacts without training

decision_rule: M1213 passes if the repeat is audited without claim expansion and routes to a specific synthesis, repeat, repair, or causal-gate milestone.
